entities.name: Fruela of Cantabria
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Fruela of Cantabria, or Fruela Pérez, was a member of the powerful Asturian royal family and played a pivotal role in the unification of the Iberian Peninsula during the early Middle Ages.

As the younger brother of King Alfonso I of Asturias, Fruela was instrumental in his brother's military campaigns against the Moors, helping to secure key victories at the Battle of Covadonga (722 CE) and the Battle of Guadalete (711 CE).

Despite his significant contributions to the Asturian kingdom, Fruela's legacy is somewhat overshadowed by that of his brother and more famous contemporaries, yet his influence on the early Christianization of Spain and the establishment of the Kingdom of Asturias remains substantial.
